fontSize.description: Set the font size, with the unit being fp. Default is about 16fp.

fontWeight.description: Font weight of the text. Supports number, default 500, or string enum: normal/regular=400, medium=500, bold=700, bolder=900.

maxFontSize.description: Maximum text display size in fp. If maxFontSize <= 0 or maxFontSize < minFontSize, adaptive font sizing is disabled and fontSize, or its default value, is used.

minFontSize.description: Minimum text display size in fp. If minFontSize <= 0, adaptive font sizing is disabled and fontSize, or its default value, is used.

fontScaleMode.description: Font scaling mode. followSystem follows the system font scale. custom uses the configured custom font scale range.

minFontScale.description: Minimum font zoom ratio. Value range: [0, 1]. Values less than 0 are clamped to 0, values greater than 1 are clamped to 1, and non-number values do not take effect.

maxFontScale.description: Maximum font zoom ratio. Value range: [1, inf). Values less than 1 are clamped to 1, and non-number values do not take effect.

action.description: Click response action. Supports server events in the form { event: { name, context } } and client functions in the form { functionCall: FunctionCall }. Default is an empty object.

fontColor.description: Set font color. Hex color string.
